note: Grok Bot plugins/connectors referenced by this template. Not auto-configured in Pi; add equivalent MCP servers with `pi mcp add` or .pi/mcp.json.

plugins.name: GitHub
plugins.description: Required. Clones the website repo, opens the branch and the pull request for every change, and reads the pull request checks for a preview URL. Never merges.

plugins.name: Google Drive
plugins.description: Optional. Reads landing page briefs and picks up images or exports that belong on a page. A paste or an upload works instead.

plugins.name: Slack
plugins.description: Optional. A destination for the weekly audit instead of this chat, when you name a channel. Read only otherwise.

plugins.name: Figma
plugins.description: Optional. Reads the design reference a brief points at so a page matches the intended layout. Read only, and the repo's existing components still win.
